institutionName: Model Institute of Engineering and Technology (MIET), Jammu

overview.description: The supplied summary describes MIET as an autonomous engineering institution in Jammu with an emphasis on hands-on innovation, research, and community development.

claims.claim: First private, UGC-approved autonomous engineering college in Jammu and Kashmir

communityOutreach.name: JK GRAM Project
communityOutreach.category: rural digital inclusion and community outreach
communityOutreach.description: The supplied summary says student volunteers map rural infrastructure gaps and build micro-websites for villages to support data-driven governance.

communityOutreach.name: AICTE VAANI — Exploring Artificial Intelligence through Dogri
communityOutreach.description: The supplied summary describes NLP work to preserve Dogri language and digitize local heritage.

communityOutreach.name: Institutional Social Responsibility (ISR) outreach
communityOutreach.description: The supplied summary mentions outreach efforts, including modern learning setups at Government Middle School in Amb Village.

technicalInnovationProjects.name: Center for Research, Innovation & Entrepreneurship (CRIE)
technicalInnovationProjects.description: Described in the supplied summary as an internship-driven incubation center supporting projects in Applied AI, Cyber-Physical Systems and Deep Learning, with industry mentorship.

technicalInnovationProjects.name: TAIWS (Ten AI Weapon System)
technicalInnovationProjects.description: The supplied summary describes a multidisciplinary project developed with the Indian Army and IIT Bombay, using secondary-vision tracking algorithms for border surveillance in rough terrain.

technicalInnovationProjects.name: Smart medical screening tools
technicalInnovationProjects.description: The supplied summary says student innovators developed hardware tools intended for low-cost, non-invasive early detection of neurodegenerative disorders in rural diagnostic settings.

technicalInnovationProjects.name: Automated agro-sorting systems
technicalInnovationProjects.description: The supplied summary describes CNN-based computer vision systems to automate agricultural sorting and help farmers improve crop pricing.

researchInfrastructureAndPartnerships.name: Unity 3D Development Platform linkage
researchInfrastructureAndPartnerships.description: The supplied summary mentions a Unity 3D development platform linkage for AR/VR simulations.

researchInfrastructureAndPartnerships.description: The supplied summary lists these organizations in relation to specialized campus centers or developer setups.

researchInfrastructureAndPartnerships.name: IIT Jammu academic and research collaboration
researchInfrastructureAndPartnerships.description: The supplied summary describes an MoU and joint center with IIT Jammu, with opportunities for specialized minor degrees and access to advanced laboratories.
